How to learn — 3 rounds

Round 1: Look at Mia, say the word, flip and check the transcription + translation.
Round 2: Mark each card I know it or Still learning, then hit 🎯 Practise tricky ones and repeat until the tricky pile is empty.
Round 3: For every card, say a true sentence about yourself: “I am proud of…” · “I get anxious about…”
